about.title: About Build //localhost
about.text: Microsoft Build //localhost is a global series of community-led, hands-on, in-person learning events designed to extend Microsoft Build content into local technical communities. Hosted between June 4–26, 2026, each event includes demos, hands-on labs, and opportunities to connect with fellow developers.
